errors.text: The proposed requirement to retain a single-phase fcc structure directly conflicts with the target mechanism, which depends on coexistence of fcc and C14 Laves phases.
The intervention is not a single, compositionally defined intervention: Ti, Nb, and Mo are offered interchangeably without evidence that they produce the same structure or magnetic response.
No supporting observations from earlier work are cited, despite this being explicitly required.
The proposed composition series is not constrained sufficiently to ensure that every tested alloy remains almost equiatomic and has configurational entropy of at least 1.0R.
